:::{#exm-log-odds-auto}
#### Log-odds that a car in the Auto data is American

For the event $A$ of @exm-odds-auto,
the log-odds of @def-log-odds are:

```{r}
#| code-fold: false
log(p_american / (1 - p_american))
```

The log-odds is positive because the odds exceed 1:
an American car is more likely than not.
:::
